name: band air bike
description: A pedaling motion on your back with band resistance. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band looped around your feet and hold the ends.
Raise your legs and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Pedal one leg in while extending the other.
Twist your torso to bring the opposite elbow to the knee.
Keep a steady rhythm and keep your core tight.
